tour_type.morning: 🏰 Bratislava Castle: * Begin with the city's best view — white castle walls, neat courtyards and a full panorama over the Danube. → | 🌳 Castle Hill Gardens: * Pleasant paths, quiet corners and great photo spots. → | 🏛️ St. Martin’s Cathedral: * Iconic Gothic church located right below the castle. → | ☕ Coffee in Old Town: * Cozy cafés with calm morning vibes.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Walk: * Narrow medieval streets, pastel façades and charming squares. → | 🗿 Cumil ‘Man at Work’: * Fun city mascot statue — a must for a quick photo. → | 🧭 Michael’s Gate: * The last preserved medieval gate with a cool tower. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Slovak Specialties: * Try halušky-style dishes, soups, dumplings or veggie options.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Promenade or UFO Bridge Viewing Path: * Warm sky, river reflections and the perfect chill moment above the water.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old-Town Evening Walk or Riverbank Chill: * Gentle nighttime strolls, dessert cafés, calm squares and safe relaxed vibes.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Bratislava Castle: * Start your day at the city’s iconic white castle — clean courtyards, sweeping Danube panoramas and a perfect bird’s-eye view of the entire old town. → | 🌳 Castle Hill Gardens: * Enjoy peaceful garden paths, greenery, open viewpoints and plenty of spots for easy morning photos. → | 🏛️ St. Martin’s Cathedral: * Head down to the foot of the hill to visit this Gothic landmark — historically important and visually striking. → | ☕ Coffee in the Old Town: * Take a relaxing break in a cozy café, surrounded by pastel façades and calm morning vibes.; Afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Walk: * Stroll through narrow medieval streets, charming squares and colorful buildings — Bratislava’s historic center feels warm and intimate. → | 🗿 Cumil ‘Man at Work’: * Stop by the city’s famous playful mascot statue — a fun photo opportunity and a small but memorable Bratislava classic. → | 🧭 Michael’s Gate: * Visit the last standing medieval gate, crowned by a tower with great old-town perspective views. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Slovak Specialties: * Try comforting dishes like bryndza halušky, soups, dumplings, cabbage dishes or veggie-friendly traditional meals.; Sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Promenade or UFO Bridge Viewing Path: * Watch warm evening colors reflect on the river — choose between a peaceful riverside stroll or elevated viewpoints near the UFO bridge for dramatic sunset scenes.; Night: 🌃 Old-Town Evening Walk or Riverbank Chill: * End your day with a gentle nighttime stroll through softly lit squares, dessert cafés, relaxed streets or quiet moments along the river — safe, calm and atmospheric.

interest_descriptions.History & Castles 🏰: Bratislava Castle stands proud above the Danube — a white fortress with centuries of stories and unbeatable views. A perfect mix of history and scenery.
interest_descriptions.Old Town Architecture 🏛️: Wander narrow medieval streets, admire colorful façades, and explore Gothic, Baroque and Renaissance details tucked into every corner of the old town.
interest_descriptions.Riverside Walks 🌊: The Danube flows alongside peaceful promenades and breezy bridges — perfect for strolling, relaxing, or catching golden reflections at sunset.
interest_descriptions.Art & Culture 🎨: From galleries to quirky statues in the street, Bratislava blends tradition with modern creativity in a fun and easygoing way.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Try hearty Slovak meals like dumplings and stews, cozy pastries or modern takes on traditional dishes — the city’s food scene is warm and satisfying.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Panoramic castle terraces, colorful old town alleys, and iconic river views — Bratislava is full of picture-perfect moments.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Slovak classics like bryndza dumplings, cabbage stews, soups, and sweet pastries offer rich flavors rooted in tradition — comforting and full of soul.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Quick bites include bakery pies, sausage sandwiches, street snacks, and hearty soups — perfect when exploring on foot.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Bratislava offers plenty for non-meat eaters — veggie dumplings, soups, potato dishes, and creative modern plates in cozy cafés.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Whether you're into traditional or modern, meat-heavy or plant-based, Bratislava’s diverse food spots make it easy to find your perfect plate.
